scope: End‑to‑end purchase flow for TTACart: login, add to cart, cart review, checkout and order confirmation
risks: Flaky price calculations may cause total verification to fail intermittently
UI element selectors may change across releases
Network latency could delay page navigation leading to timeout
coverage_gap: Existing library lacks positive tests for cart review (product quantity), checkout information entry, order total calculation verification, and successful order confirmation flow after checkout. Only negative navigation to checkout‑complete is covered (TTA-018).

test_cases.title: Login with valid credentials redirects to products page
test_cases.expected_result: User lands on /playwright/ttacart/inventory and the Products heading is visible

test_cases.title: Login with invalid credentials shows error message
test_cases.expected_result: Error alert reads 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service' and URL remains on the login page

test_cases.title: Add first product to cart updates cart badge to 1
steps: On the inventory page click the "Add to cart" button for the first product
Read the cart badge in the header

test_cases.title: Cart review displays added product with quantity 1
steps: Add the first product to the cart
Click the cart icon to navigate to /playwright/ttacart/cart
test_cases.expected_result: The product appears in the cart list with a quantity of 1

test_cases.title: Checkout information entry leads to overview page
steps: From the cart page click the "Checkout" button
On /playwright/ttacart/checkout-step-one enter First Name John, Last Name Doe, Zip/Postal Code 12345

test_cases.title: Order total equals item total plus tax on overview page
steps: On the Checkout Overview page read the displayed Item total value
test_cases.expected_result: Item total plus Tax equals the displayed Total

test_cases.title: Finish checkout shows order confirmation heading
steps: On the Checkout Overview page click the "Finish" button
test_cases.expected_result: URL changes to /playwright/ttacart/checkout-complete and the heading "Thank you for your order!" is visible
